native_g1g2_mms_alignment.next_run_gate: The scoped authored_ast selector reversibly mutates one source-expression fixture with candidate-authored constant, affine and pre-held-out quadratic roots. For each root it rebuilds the actual current-source T1 package, compiles through the same Native compiler, and runs the existing Gridap level-1 consumer. Require constant probes 1/1/1 and RHS integral 24; affine probes 1/1.5/2 and RHS integral 36; quadratic probes 1/1.25/2 and RHS integral 32; residual_abs <= 1e-9, residual_rel <= 1e-11, finite valid downstream Q1 state, NA MMS reference and distinct RHS/state hashes across variants. These are bounded source-consumer checks only; UP2-01 remains incomplete until its related time and multifield scope is examined, and there is no parent-goal, physical-validity or acceptance credit.
